data.description:
## Testing Mode: RED

Write failing tests in `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_marker.py` covering extended PR marker comment posting + ledger append after review.

## Tests to add

1. `test_post_cycle_marker_creates_new_comment_when_absent`: PR_NUMBER set, no existing DSO-Review-Cycle marker for cycle K + commit_sha; mock gh pr comment; assert new comment is created with body matching format `DSO-Review-Cycle: K commit_sha=<sha> findings_hash=<h> tuples=<json>`.
2. `test_post_cycle_marker_updates_existing`: existing comment with same cycle K + commit_sha marker; assert UPDATE call (gh api PATCH or equivalent), not CREATE.
3. `test_post_cycle_marker_skips_when_no_pr`: PR_NUMBER unset; assert no gh calls, function returns gracefully.
4. `test_append_cycle_called_after_review`: full main() with mocked dispatch returning findings; assert cycle_ledger.append_cycle called with cycle_num, finding tuples (file, line_range, category), commit_sha, findings_hash.
5. `test_findings_hash_computed_correctly`: assert findings_hash matches sha256 of sorted finding_hash tuples joined by '|'.

## Behavioral assertions

Mock cycle_ledger.append_cycle, gh CLI subprocess.run, and reviewed dispatch. Assert OBSERVABLE outcomes (comment body content, ledger entry shape, hash determinism).

## Acceptance

All 5 tests fail on current main: `_post_cycle_marker_comment` and `append_cycle` calls do not exist in runner.py.

## File Impact

- tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_marker.py (new, ~180 lines)
